scenes.headline: Your coding agent thinks out loud.
scenes.support: The reasoning is already in the log.
sentences: Your coding agent thinks in full sentences, and shows you almost none of them.
Reezyn reads that thinking out loud.

scenes.headline: It waits for the pause.
scenes.support: 700 ms debounce · 9 s stale · 30 s dedupe
sentences: Agents fire tool calls in bursts.
It waits for the pause, and keeps one thought.

scenes.headline: Six stations, no model in the middle.
sentences: Adapter, coalescer, cleaner, then Kokoro, on your Mac.

scenes.headline: Whatever you drive, it listens.
sentences: Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, OpenCode, Freebuff: watched directly.

scenes.headline: The whole app is one menu.
sentences: Pause, skip, and a recap, in the menu bar.
The CC viewer floats the line over your editor.

scenes.headline: Reply without the keyboard.
sentences: Say Reezyn, and dictate; it types the draft and never sends it.
When the turn ends it speaks the answer, and the mic reopens.

scenes.headline: The session comes with you.
sentences: Away from the desk, the session is on your phone.

scenes.headline: Local by construction.
sentences: No cloud, no telemetry, no summary model.
Updates are verified before they land.

scenes.headline: Then it just talks.
scenes.support: free · open source · macOS 13 or later
sentences: Free, open source, a minute to install.
